details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: daemon module-root path traversal via a symlinked
     module path when "use chroot" is disabled
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53784.patch: add the ownership-walk
       resolver open_no_attacker_symlinks() to syscall.c and use it in
       change_dir() for an absolute target of a non-chrooted daemon, so
       a symlink planted on the module root or any of its parents can no
       longer steer the daemon's CWD outside the module; the resolver
       opens a pipe, socket or anonymous inode named by /dev/stderr,
       /dev/fd/N or /proc/self/fd/N as that object instead of failing
       with ENOENT
     - CVE-2026-53784
   * SECURITY UPDATE: arbitrary file overwrite via symlinked ancillary
     output paths
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53803.patch: open the --log-file /
       "log file", --write-batch / --read-batch, "motd file",
       "lock file" and rsyncd.conf paths through
       open_no_attacker_symlinks(), and refuse a --read-batch file that
       is neither a regular file nor a FIFO
     - CVE-2026-53803
